notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section 458bbb–1, Pub. L. 93–638, title V, § 502, as added Pub. L. 106–568, title XIII, § 1302, Dec. 27, 2000, 114 Stat. 2938, was renumbered section 802 of Pub.
